Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Finance asked me to confirm a few commercial items before we progress the PO:

- Pricing schedule: can you confirm whether the per-token bands in the attached pricing spreadsheet are fixed for the term or subject to FX/annual CPI adjustments?
- Minimum commit: the draft Order Form calls out a 12-month minimum. We prefer a shorter ramp — is 6 months possible with a volume-based true-up?
- Currency & invoicing: Orchard is set up to pay in GBP. If you require USD billing, please confirm an explicit currency-fallback clause and the exchange rate source.
- Net terms: Finance prefers Net30. Your order form shows Net45. Any flexibility?
- VAT/Tax: who is responsible for VAT? We will provide a VAT certificate if needed.

I've attached our PO template and a UK VAT cert (redacted) for reference. Can you send a redlined Order Form and confirm what evidence you need for VAT handling?

If easier, happy to do a short call — Liam (procurement) and I can be available this afternoon.

Best,

Orchard Health

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below; I've attached a redline of the Order Form for legal to review.

1) Pricing schedule: the token bands in the worksheet are fixed for the agreed term in the Order Form but we can add a single annual CPI cap (max 3%) rather than an open FX pass-through. See redline section 2.
2) Minimum commit: we can move to a 6-month ramp with a volume-based true-up at month 6. Proposed language in redline §3.
3) Currency & invoicing: primary billing entity language references USD (Redwood, Inc.). We can accept GBP invoicing for EU customers by adding a currency fallback clause that uses the ECB published rate on the invoice date and a fee-preserving rounding band. Proposed clause in redline §5.
4) Net terms: standard is Net45 for enterprise. For Orchard we can offer Net30 if we receive a signed PO and an upfront 25% activation prepayment, or Net45 with no prepayment.
5) VAT/Tax: we prefer reverse-charge when applicable; if Orchard supplies a valid VAT registration certificate (attached), we'll make invoices VAT-exempt and list your VAT ID on the invoice. If not supplied, we'll charge VAT where required and issue gross invoices.

I've attached: OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf and pricing-schedule-v2.xlsx (updated to show CPI cap). Can you confirm whether Orchard is able to provide a VAT registration for the billing entity and whether PO workflow supports a 25% activation payment?

If you want to jump on a quick 20-min call, Ben and I are free 16:00 BST today.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Lead — Europe
Redwood Inference
